advance_prep.instruction: Soak navy beans overnight, discard the water

steps.text: Soak the beans overnight, discard the water and boil hard for 10 minutes, then simmer until tender, about 45 minutes.
steps.cue: A bean crushes easily between two fingers. Boil hard for the first 10 minutes.

steps.text: Soften onion, carrot, celery and garlic in oil, then add tomatoes and thyme.
Add the beans with 1 litre of water and simmer 15 minutes.
steps.cue: The vegetables are soft and the broth has a little body.

steps.text: Stir in sliced kale for the last 5 minutes and add salt.
Top each bowl with 80 g Greek yoghurt just before serving. It adds protein and cools the heat.
steps.cue: The yogurt is cold and the soup is hot. Serve at once.
